summary: Bitdeer Technologies Group filed a Form 6-K containing a press release with routine monthly production and operations updates for July 2026. It reports 1,190 Bitcoin mined (up 322% YoY), self-mining hash rate of 76.7 EH/s, and AI Cloud ARR of ~$76M. The release also highlights a previously announced $4.7B 16-year AI/HPC data center lease with Volta for the Tydal, Norway campus, but this is not a new transaction. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is announced. The filing is a standard operational update, so it does not qualify as a special situation.
